CMOS flying-capacitor voltage inverter
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VP1 p1 0 PULSE(0 3.3 20n 10n 10n 430n 1u)
VP2 p2 0 PULSE(0 3.3 520n 10n 10n 430n 1u)
XDUT vdd 0 out p1 p2 astra_066_cmos_flying_cap_voltage_inverter
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec inverted range -3.4 -2.9 unit=V
* @spec ripple range 0 0.1 unit=V
* @spec final range -3.4 -2.9 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 5n 100u
meas tran inverted AVG v(out) FROM=80u TO=100u
meas tran ripple PP v(out) FROM=80u TO=100u
meas tran final FIND v(out) AT=100u
write out.raw v(out) v(p1) v(p2)
quit
.endc
.end
